newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica's chairman to visit P.Telecom Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica's chairman to visit P.Telecom Wednesday.

text.p: Juan Villalonga, chairman of Telefonica de Espana, will travel to Portugal next Wednesday to meet with the head of Portugal Telecom, Francisco Murteira Nabo, and with Planning Minister Joao Cravinho, a Telefonica spokesman said.
The spokesman gave no further information about the trip.
Industry sources said the two operators could study an exchange of shares and the possibility of combining efforts to penetrate Latin American markets.
Telefonica -- through its international division TISA -- participates in the management of 10 million service lines in Latin American.
It holds key stakes in operators in Chile, Argentina, Peru, Venezuela and the south of Brazil. Portugal Telecom has formed an alliance with Brasilian operator Telebras.
